Summarize a topic model

Source: R/evaluate.R
summary.sbert_topic_model.Rd

summary() reports the quality of a fitted topic model: the number of documents (and segments), topics, and the embedding model; the share of the embedding variance between topics; the mean coherence of the topics' terms; and the diversity of the terms. Below this overview, a table gives the size and coherence of every topic, so that small or incoherent topics stand out. A fit whose k-means did not converge is reported as such.

The result is an object that prints as the report; calling summary() does not print by itself.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sbert_topic_model'
summary(object, measure = c("npmi", "umass"), n_terms = 10L, ...)

Arguments

object

A topic model fitted by topics().

measure

Coherence measure passed to coherence(): "npmi" (default) or "umass".

n_terms

Top terms per topic used for coherence and diversity (default 10).

...

Ignored.

Value

A data frame of class summary.sbert_topic_model with one row per topic and columns topic, label, n_documents, proportion, and coherence. The overview is kept with it and printed above the table; as.data.frame() returns the table as a plain data frame.

Conditions

An error of class sbert_no_terms when the model has no terms.

See also

coherence() and topic_diversity() for the measures; topic_sizes(); print.summary.sbert_topic_model().

Examples

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
topic_model <- topics(corpus, n_topics = 6, column = "translation",
                      embeddings = feedback_embeddings)
summary(topic_model)
#> Semantic topic model summary
#>   documents:            600
#>   topics:               6
#>   model:                precomputed embeddings
#>   between/total SS:     22.6%
#>   mean npmi  coherence:  -0.1044
#>   topic diversity:      0.917 (top 10 terms)
#> 
#>  topic                                                       label n_documents
#>      1   Where is the cow and the cake? Choose all the pictures...         223
#>      2            All the ones between the cat and the strawberry.         133
#>      3         What does “all the ones between the leaf and the...         131
#>      4 Are you sure you have fewer pictures in the red box than...          49
#>      5      In the top middle box, it means something is in the...          37
#>      6    It is not a person, does not have a hat, and is sitting.          27
#>  proportion coherence
#>     0.37167   -0.2368
#>     0.22167   -0.4150
#>     0.21833   -0.2564
#>     0.08167    0.3011
#>     0.06167   -0.2043
#>     0.04500    0.1849
as.data.frame(summary(topic_model))
